commands:
set -eu
base=/Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/work
wt=/Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/worktrees/macbook-trackpad-zoom
expected=91334a76de1e8d239c68dff9c29002847a6c5097
test "$(git -C "$wt" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$expected"
test "$(git -C "$wt" branch --show-current)" = fix/macbook-trackpad-zoom
test -z "$(git -C "$wt" status --porcelain=v1)"
test -x "$base/frontend/node_modules/.bin/vite"
test -x "$base/backend/.venv/bin/python"
cmp "$base/frontend/package-lock.json" "$wt/frontend/package-lock.json"
for pair in "frontend/node_modules" "backend/.venv"; do
  if test ! -e "$wt/$pair" && test ! -L "$wt/$pair"; then
    ln -s "$base/$pair" "$wt/$pair"
  fi
  test "$(readlink "$wt/$pair")" = "$base/$pair"
done
echo PHOTOMAP_ZOOM_DEPENDENCIES_LINKED
"$wt/backend/.venv/bin/python" -c 'import fastapi, alembic, sqlmodel, uvicorn; print("PYTHON_DEPENDENCIES_OK")'
cd "$wt"
mkdir -p backend/data backend/storage/private backend/storage/public .dev
if test ! -e backend/data/app.db && test -f "$base/backend/data/app.db"; then
  SOURCE_DB="$base/backend/data/app.db" TARGET_DB="$wt/backend/data/app.db" "$wt/backend/.venv/bin/python" - <<'PY'
import os, sqlite3
source = sqlite3.connect("file:" + os.environ["SOURCE_DB"] + "?mode=ro", uri=True)
target = sqlite3.connect(os.environ["TARGET_DB"])
source.backup(target)
print("COPIED_MAC_SQLITE_SNAPSHOT=" + str(target.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()[0]))
target.close()
source.close()
PY
fi
if test -d "$base/backend/storage"; then
  source_kb=$(du -sk "$base/backend/storage" | awk '{print $1}')
  free_kb=$(df -Pk "$wt" | awk 'NR==2 {print $4}')
  printf 'SOURCE_MEDIA_KB=%s FREE_KB=%s\n' "$source_kb" "$free_kb"
  if test "$free_kb" -gt "$((source_kb * 2 + 1048576))"; then
    rsync -a --exclude='*.tmp' "$base/backend/storage/" "$wt/backend/storage/"
    echo MAC_MEDIA_SNAPSHOT_COPIED
  else
    echo MAC_MEDIA_COPY_SKIPPED_INSUFFICIENT_FREE_SPACE
  fi
else
  echo MAC_SOURCE_MEDIA_NOT_PRESENT
fi
printf 'LOCAL_DB=%s\n' "$(test -f backend/data/app.db && echo present || echo missing)"
printf 'LOCAL_STORAGE_KB=%s\n' "$(du -sk backend/storage | awk '{print $1}')"
printf 'ZOOM_HEAD=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
printf 'ZOOM_CLEAN_COUNT=%s\n' "$(git status --porcelain=v1 | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
printf 'AGENT_WORK_CLEAN_COUNT=%s\n' "$(git -C "$base" status --porcelain=v1 | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
echo PHOTOMAP_ZOOM_LOCAL_PREPARED
